test_title: PYST 176: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Neeta, Vinita, Satya, Kamini, Divya and Alpa are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Alpa is to the immediate right of Vinita. Kamini is between Neeta and Satya. Divya is between Neeta and Vinita. Who is sitting third to the left of Satya?
solution:
Total person:- Six → Neeta, Vinita, Satya, Kamini, Divya and Alpa

1) Alpa is to the immediate right of Vinita.

2) Divya is between Neeta and Vinita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ff3febccb628db27b5908bfa4efb0df07b15032944e474de1cfdce514ad910f.png] 

3) Kamini is between Neeta and Satya. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91f321f03f9117e87ba1cc262748f0fb9a4a76b9e6e8e24c5b22955b4d2de9f8.png] 

 

Thus, ‘Divya' is sitting third to the left of Satya.

Hence, the correct answer is "Divya".
